video_title: Tim Hardaway Sr CALLS OUT Doc Rivers for “Bush League” Giannis Comment

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on the Miami Heat's early season struggles
quotes.excerpt: they still trying to figure things out. They got all new players, you know, Tim, Clay, Giannis
quotes.quote: They still trying to figure things out. They got all new players, you know, Tim, Clay, Giannis. Donovan Mitchell is playing starting at point guard all year for the first time. They just trying to figure out and Spo is still trying to figure out. He sat down Wiggins and not starting him no more. He wants him to come off the bench and give something off the bench. We knew that Clay wasn't going to shoot like that and not shoot well all season long. We been waiting for him to break out and he broke out.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on the benefits of playing tough teams
quotes.excerpt: playing a one and 17 team in Sacramento and Utah, that can help your team
quotes.quote: Playing a one and 17 team in Sacramento and Utah, that can help your team. That can help your team because it's like practice. You coming in here and you practicing against guys that's trying to win the game, but you running your plays, you practicing. They doing just like everybody else is doing to you that's been doing to you that won them games. They shrinking the floor, they making Giannis pass, they making him be a playmaker, they making him understand what type of team he has.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on the importance of letting point guards play
quotes.excerpt: if you got a point guard, you got to let that point guard play point guard
quotes.quote: If you got a point guard, you got to let that point guard play point guard and let him do the things that he's capable of doing out there on the court like running plays and getting your team into plays. And if you don't get your team into plays, everybody's just standing there. Giannis, he's a dominating guy that with the ball, he's looking for his shot, he's looking to go against three or four guys and then make the pass. I think you got to run offense and then let Giannis be Giannis in the open court.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on his wife's influence on his career
quotes.excerpt: you learned the hard way. My wife of 35 years
quotes.quote: You learned the hard way. My wife of 35 years. She been with me when I had nothing, when we came into this with nothing. We started everything together and you got to listen. You got to listen to your wife, you got to listen to your best friend, you got to listen to the person that care about you.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr criticizes Doc Rivers' comments on Giannis
quotes.excerpt: I didn't like that. I thought it was bush league. I thought it was terrible
quotes.quote: I didn't like that. I thought it was bush league. I thought it was terrible. When I first heard it, I was like, oh, you can't say that. You can't say he don't have basketball IQ. If he didn't have basketball IQ, he wouldn't be a professional basketball player. He wouldn't be a MVP, he wouldn't have won a championship. He wouldn't have figured out a lot of things out there on the court that needed to be figured out when they won a championship.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on Giannis's basketball IQ and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I think Giannis have a good basketball IQ. I think Giannis need to learn his team
quotes.quote: I think Giannis have a good basketball IQ. I think Giannis need to learn his team, just like the team needs to learn Giannis. Everybody's new and they running a different offense. I want them to get back into pick and roll and pick and roll and getting that them guards downhill, getting Clay open to make jump shots. If you come off Giannis, their guard is not going to be able to stick Giannis. You get that ball to Giannis, he going to take that guard to the hole and make something happen.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on the Lakers' championship potential
quotes.excerpt: if they stay healthy, they get close. I don't think they'll beat out the guys like Denver
quotes.quote: If they stay healthy, they get close. I don't think they'll beat out the guys like Denver, OKC, Minnesota when they get whole, San Antonio Spurs. I don't think that they they will beat them in a seven game series. But I tell you this, you cannot put and let Luka just kill you. You got to go and double team. You got to go and make other the other teammates make shots and make plays, which they are doing.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on the Lakers' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: they constructed a real good team like they did in Dallas when they went to the championship
quotes.quote: They constructed a real good team like they did in Dallas when they went to the championship. It's like the same team. The same exact team that go and win a championship. But you know you got to understand, you know Luka is not going to play defense. So everybody got to be in help mode. Everybody got to be in help mode. You know Luka is not going to come back and get to the referees. So it's going to be five on four. Everybody got to is like a zone where you got to get out to that man, come back down on defense.

quotes.speaker: Tim Hardaway Sr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Hardaway Sr on Austin Reaves' status as an All-Star
quotes.excerpt: I think we could we could legitimately say that Austin Reaves is a All-Star
quotes.quote: I think we could we could legitimately say that Austin Reaves is a All-Star. I think everybody need to stop stop saying, you know, well, I don't know, well, you know, we'll see. Yeah, Austin Reaves is a All-Star. A super All-Star? No, but a All-Star? Yes, and he's showing it each and every night.
